versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-flink-python-job-submission.

- Enables submission and management of PyFlink jobs on Alibaba Cloud Realtime Compute for Apache Flink.
- Supports artifact upload, deployment creation, configuration updates, cross-session recovery, and state-aware start/stop actions.
- Enforces best practices for credential and permissions handling; does not allow direct AK/SK input.
- Guides environment setup and dependency installation, including Aliyun CLI and required Python packages.
- Routes SQL and deletion-only job requests to the appropriate skill.
